--- stdout
Operator maintenance that shrinks live state. Each terminal task's acceptance
receipt moves into an immutable, content-addressed archive object, and the task
keeps a digest reference; inspection restores the receipt from the archive.
Works in bounded batches, releasing the state lock between them, until no
eligible receipt remains. Merges already archive after each new merge; use this
to drain an existing backlog.
Usage:
liza archive-acceptance-receipts [flags]
Flags:
-h, --help help for archive-acceptance-receipts
--json output result as structured JSON
--max-bytes int soft byte budget of archive objects per state transaction (default 4194304)
--max-tasks int maximum tasks archived per state transaction (default 8)
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
